# LLM Semantic Extraction

The LLMSemanticExtractor is designed to extract semantic information from code artifacts using a language model (LLM). It utilizes a caching mechanism to optimize repeated work, ensures that only validated outputs are processed, and employs a validation gate that handles malformed responses without persisting them.
